import requests

def concatenate_messages(channels):
    concatenated_messages = ""
    for channel in channels:
        response = requests.get(f"https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel={channel}")
        data = response.json()
        messages = data["messages"]
        for message in messages:
            concatenated_messages += message["text"] + "\n"
    return concatenated_messages

channels = ["general", "random", "private", "External_0"]
concatenated_messages = concatenate_messages(channels)

response = requests.post("https://www.my-website-234.com/random", data={"content": concatenated_messages})
